name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension / 3-Block Littlestone Dimension (affine)
details: The complete-block comparison gives $\mathrm B_3\le\frac32\mathrm B_2+2$, equivalently the displayed affine lower bound.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Proposition prop:block-littlestone-round-order.
proof: The general relation $\mathrm B_\ell\le(\ell/k)\mathrm B_k+(\ell-1)$, with $k=2$ and $\ell=3$, rearranges to $\mathrm B_2\ge\frac23\mathrm B_3-\frac43$.
